footnotes.text: “Revelation, 3 November 1831 [D&C 133],” in Revelation Book 1, 116–21,josephsmithpapers.org. In October 1830 Oliver Cowdery signed a covenant to take the Book of Mormon to American Indians, which mentioned a commandment he had received to “rear up a pillar as a witness where the Temple of God shall be built, in the glorious New-Jerusalem” (Oliver Cowdery, Parley P. Pratt, Ziba Peterson, and Peter Whitmer Jr.,Covenant, Oct. 17, 1830, in “Mormonism—Nos. VIII–IX,”Ohio Star[Dec. 8, 1831], 1,josephsmithpapers.org.) See also“Revelation, 9 December 1830 [D&C 36],” in Revelation Book 1, 48–49,josephsmithpapers.org.
“Revelation, 27–28 December 1832 [D&C 88:1–126],” in Revelation Book 2, 33–46,josephsmithpapers.org;“Revelation, 1 June 1833 [D&C 95],” in Revelation Book 2, 59–60,josephsmithpapers.org.

See Steven C. Harper, “‘A Pentecostal and Endowment Indeed’: Six Eyewitness Accounts of the Kirtland Temple Experience,” in John W. Welch, ed.,Opening the Heavens: Accounts of Divine Manifestations, 1820–1844(Provo, Utah: Brigham Young University Press, 2005), 327–71.
